name: Vercel Geist (design system + Geist font family)
vendor: Vercel (font with Basement Studio, Andres Briganti)
licence: Geist font: SIL OFL 1.1 (vercel/geist-font, npm geist 1.7.2). Design system docs/tokens: public documentation, no open-source licence declared; components (Vercel dashboard) are not published as a package. Study structure and values only.
bestFor: developer tools, infra and AI dashboards
docs and marketing sites for technical products
dark-first, black-and-white brands with one signal colour
products with dense data tables, logs and code
avoidFor: products needing a rich multi-hue illustrative palette
teams needing an installable component package (Geist components are documented, not distributed)

families: Geist Sans (variable, 100-900 + italics; named weights Thin, UltraLight, Light, Regular, Medium, SemiBold, Bold, ExtraBold, Black, UltraBlack)
typography.notes: Consumed as Tailwind utility classes text-{heading|copy|label|button}-N that set size, line-height, letter-spacing and weight together (from Geist Core Figma). Headings are weight 600 with strongly negative tracking (-0.06em at 72px, -0.04em at 24-32px, -0.02em at 14-16px). A nested <strong> modifies weight: in headings it drops to 500 and colour to gray-900 ('Subtle'); in copy it goes to weight 550 and gray-1000 ('Strong'). Label 13 supports tabular numerals. Roles: Heading = page/section titles; Button = only inside button components (14 default, 16 largest, 12 only for tiny buttons inside inputs); Label = single-line with generous line-height for icon pairing (14 is the most common text style, used in menus); Copy = multi-line with higher line-height (14 is most common body; 13 for secondary/space-premium; 16 for modals; 18-24 marketing hero). Mono sizes are paired one step smaller than adjacent sans (Label 13 Mono pairs with Label 14). Source: https://vercel.com/geist/typography and site CSS.

color.model: hex (sRGB) with lab()/display-p3 variants; scales are 10 steps (100-1000)

neutrals.note: Two page backgrounds: Background 1 (light #fff / dark #0a0a0a) default, Background 2 (light #fafafa / dark #000) used sparingly for subtle differentiation. Legacy tokens still present: --geist-foreground #000 / white, --geist-background #fff / #000, accents-1..8.

accents.note: Dark hex values were converted from the published HSL (--ds-X-N-value) and may differ by 1 unit of rounding. Light values are published hex. Colour 700-800 are identical in both themes (the saturated signal steps).

semantic.statusMapping: error=red, warning=amber, success=green (legacy: --geist-success was blue #0070f3), info/link=blue-700; teal/purple/pink for tags and categories

color.darkMode: Same 10-step ramps flip meaning-preserving values: gray-100 #f2f2f2 -> #1a1a1a, gray-1000 #171717 -> #ededed. Backgrounds go #fff -> #0a0a0a and #fafafa -> #000. Signal colours (700, 800) are unchanged; 100-300 become deep desaturated tints; 900 lightens (e.g. blue-900 #0064e2 -> ~#52a8ff). Strokes use alpha in dark (--ds-shadow-border-base 0 0 0 1px #ffffff25 vs #00000014 light). Theme switcher component with system/light/dark.
color.contrastNotes: System advertises 'a high contrast, accessible color system'. Text steps: 900 secondary, 1000 primary. Grid docs state custom borders can fall below the 3:1 minimum while default tokens are tuned. No published APCA/WCAG ratios per step in the pages fetched. Light gray-400 (#eaeaea) lies lighter than gray-300 (#e6e6e6) in the extracted CSS, probably a legacy/duplicate declaration: flag before using.

spacing.notes: Tokens: --geist-space 4px; 2x 8; 3x 12; 4x 16; 6x 24; 8x 32; 10x 40; 16x 64; 24x 96; 32x 128; 48x 192; 64x 256. Named sizes: small 32, medium 36, large 40 (control heights). Gap 24, gap-half 12, gap-quarter 8, section gap 32. Page margin 24px; page width 1200px (legacy --geist-page-width) or 1400px (--ds-page-width). Form tokens: small 32 / medium 36 / large 40 height; form font 14px/20px (small line-height 14px), large 16px/24px.

radius.rule: Radius is bound to elevation material, not chosen ad hoc: resting and small-raised surfaces and tooltips 6px; medium/large raised, menus and modals 12px; fullscreen 16px. Tooltip is the only floating element with a triangular stem. Buttons support shape rounded (pill) mainly for marketing.

shadows: t-shirt shadows xs/2xs/xl/2xl also defined; dark mode shadow-small 0px 1px 2px #00000029, medium uses #00000052
depth.borders: Border is a 0 0 0 1px ring drawn with box-shadow (alpha black/white), plus a 1px background-200 'halo' ring (--ds-shadow-background-border) so surfaces separate cleanly on both backgrounds. Materials (base, small, medium, large, tooltip, menu, modal, fullscreen) bundle fill + stroke + shadow + radius into one class; do not stack two materials on one element.
depth.blur: Overlay backdrop is gray-100/background-200 at 0.8 opacity (not blur). Scroller/gradient fades used for overflow.

motion.notes: Tokens: popover duration .2s swift; overlay (modal) duration .3s swift with scale .96 start. z-index bands as tokens: drawer 200, modal 300, toast 5000, menu 2001, tooltip 99999 (--ds-z-*). Loading Dots and Spinner components exist; other motion values unknown.

controlHeightsPx.button text: button-12 inside input fields (tiny), button-14 default, button-16 largest
controlHeightsPx.note: Button heights beyond the --geist-form-* tokens not read; Button sizes in docs: tiny, small, medium (default), large; types: primary (default), secondary, tertiary, error, warning; shapes: square, rounded; svgOnly icon buttons; prefix/suffix; loading; ButtonLink; CustomButton; Split Button.

density.notes: Marketing vs product density differ via copy-18..24 and heading-40..72 vs label/copy 13-14.

components.stateMatrixCompleteness: Documented per component with live examples, 'Best Practices' (When to use / Behavior / Accessibility) per page. Button: sizes x types x shapes x loading x disabled variants (default, secondary, tertiary, error, warning). Icon-only requires svgOnly + aria-label (validator throws). Copy rules baked in (Title Case verb+noun, destructive pairs with toast). Hover/active states follow the 3-step component background/border pattern (colour 1/2/3, 4/5/6) so every component has the same state ladder. Dark mode checked per component.

tokenArchitecture: Two generations coexist. Legacy: --geist-* (space, radius, foreground/background, accents-N, success/error/warning). Current: --ds-* where colours are 10-step ramps (--ds-gray-100..1000, --ds-gray-alpha-*, --ds-{blue,red,amber,green,teal,purple,pink}-100..1000, --ds-background-100/200) each also published as H,S,L triplets (--ds-X-N-value) for compositing. Materials (--ds-shadow-*, .material-*) and motion (--ds-motion-*) and z-index (--ds-z-*) have their own tokens. Typography consumed through generated utility classes. Numeric 100-1000 ramp keyed to function (1-3 bg, 4-6 border, 7-8 solid, 9-10 text).
distinctiveness: Black/white austerity with a visible grid (guide lines, crosses, dashed grid are a 'huge part of the new Vercel aesthetic'), hairline shadow-borders, tight-tracked semibold Geist headings, mono used as a first-class label voice, Title Case button copy. Elevation named by role, not number.
weaknesses: Not distributed as a package; only documentation and tokens (components not open)
Signal-colour palette is narrow; little guidance for brand colour
Colour dark values only as HSL strings; docs pages are client-rendered (no raw token table)
Legacy and current tokens coexist with conflicting meanings (success=blue)
Weights 550 and negative px tracking tuned by hand per size, not formulaic
Button size heights not documented publicly
takeaways: Name elevation by role (base, small, medium, large, tooltip, menu, modal, fullscreen) and bundle fill + stroke + shadow + radius into one material so the choice is one decision
Use a 10-step ramp with fixed jobs: 1-3 component bg (default/hover/active), 4-6 border (default/hover/active), 7-8 solid bg, 9-10 text
Typography classes set size + line-height + tracking + weight atomically, split into four roles (heading, label, copy, button) with mono siblings; tracking scales with size (-0.02em to -0.06em)
Draw borders as 1px alpha ring shadows with a background halo, in both themes
Use a strong/subtle <strong> modifier rule so emphasis is a token, not an ad hoc weight
Put per-component Best Practices (when to use, behaviour, accessibility, copy conventions) beside the visual spec
Tokenise z-index bands and overlay motion (duration .3s, start scale .96, slight-overshoot easing)
